collaboration.visual_forger: visual-forger@1.3.0 — neoplastic grid / wash / silhouette / isometric / logo / colour gates

pedagogical_boundary: Prefer neoplastic + neoplastic-macro for product chrome. Trees = Q-FA1 prologue only (what the matrix refuses). Never authenticity scores or painting facsimiles.

citations.andrzejewski: Andrzejewski, David, David G. Stork, Xiaojin Zhu, and Ron Spronk. 2010. “Inferring Compositional Style in the Neo-Plastic Paintings of Piet Mondrian by Machine Learning.” In Computer Vision and Image Analysis of Art, edited by David G. Stork, Jim Coddington, and Anna Bentkowska-Kafel, 75310G. Proceedings of SPIE 7531. https://doi.org/10.1117/12.840558.
